variants.name: IBB-032 Wyoming (MGF: Pulse Blaster, SD0 Regenerator)
variants.description: Ancient warship from Bellwing. While lacking in range, defense, and maneuverability by modern standards, its' firepower is still imposing enough to be kept in service as detterence.
variants.variant: IBB-032 Wyoming (MGF: Pulse Blaster, SD0 Regenerator)

variants.name: G-Class Container Transport (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)
variants.description: To compete with the newer, more modern heavy freighters dominating the market, the Syndicate stacked their Container Transport into a huge Heavy Container Transport, tripling capacity but also slowing it down even further from its already despised slug-pace. With barely any additional crew requirement from its predecessor, the G-Class Container Transport cargo-to-crew ratio is absolutely unmatched. 	Though still not the most capacious in the area, it can carry a pair of drones to either defend itself with or assist during unloading operations in less well-equipped ports.
variants.variant: G-Class Container Transport (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)

variants.name: FG-6 Startrain (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)
variants.description: Startrain is a medium ranged freighter offered by Freight Galactic with more limited cargo capacity than other cargo ships from the same shipyard. In exchange, it is much faster to unload, equating to shorter time in port and faster deliveries.

variants.name: FG-11 Starcarrier (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)
variants.description: A mid-sized container ship offering both great capacity and the benefits of containerization.

variants.name: AD-019A Iabayi (MGF: SD1 Regenerator)
variants.description: A larger fancy freighter for richer captains who might want to fly a ship with more cargo space than the Iaphia or travel longer distances.

variants.name: GKS-48 Zummenstoss (MGF: Pulse Blaster, SD0 Regenerator)
variants.description: A recently developed warship with focus on turrets and use it to tear down their opponent from any angle unlike most other warship on the market at the time of release. It also comes with unique weapon to surprise any enemy they face and rapidly tear down their shields.
variants.variant: GKS-48 Zummenstoss (MGF: Pulse Blaster, SD0 Regenerator)

variants.name: Typ012 Guangzhou (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster, SD0 Regenerator)
variants.description: Guangzhou class battleship designed and built by CCS Corp. is one of the largest commercially avaliable warship at its time of release often taking the role of heavy escort for cargo fleets. Though it is one of the most expensive warship on the civilian market its firepower is unmatched making it a prime choice for captains looking for non-carrier heavy escort.

variants.description: Light and fast interceptor from Bellwing with a turret mount giving it option for missile defense or even more firepower. Due to it's versatility, it's popular among both bounty hunters and militias alike.

variants.name: E-FD23 Kanran (MGF: ST0 Regenerator)
variants.description: Kanran is a very old destroyer designed by MJK heavy industries for their security department to protect their properties as well as raiding enemy convoys during the first turf war and sequentially also participated in the Alpha War. At its time it was considered one of the most advanced ship in the sky second only to those from the Deep and with sheer number it was manufactured many survived the conflict and were continually improved that some still survives to this day. Production of this model fluctuates over time but generally on descending trend before stopping not long after the formation of the Republic. Now most of Kanran on the market are ones decomissioned from NGK fleets.

variants.name: Corvette (MGF: ST0 Regenerator)
variants.description: Incorporating new, experimental lightweight materials, the Lionheart Corvette combines the speed and agility of a fighter with the armament of a heavy warship. Its weak hull is more than compensated for by its advanced shielding matrix.

variants.name: Argosy (MGF: Pulse Blaster, Shield Maxed)
variants.description: The Argosy from Southbound Shipyards is very popular with merchants not because of its capacity, which is actually slightly smaller than the Syndicate Freighter, but because it can hold its own in combat even against a small pirate fleet. 	The Argosy is also a very easy ship to upgrade with faster engines or more powerful weapons as needed, so many privately owned Argosies have very different capabilities than the stock model.

variants.name: Firebird (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)
variants.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Firebird is a warship with a long and storied past; Firebirds fought on both sides of the Alpha Wars over half a millennium ago, and although the equipment and systems have been upgraded continuously since then, the basic design remains almost the same. The Firebird is also a very rugged ship and easy to repair; supposedly a few of the Firebirds that fought in those wars are still in service today.

variants.name: Splinter (MGF: Heavy Pulse Blaster)
variants.description: The Splinter is the largest warship produced by the Megaparsec shipyard. It is designed to be faster and more maneuverable than other ships of a similar size, in order to serve as a heavy escort ship or as part of a planetary defense and patrol fleet. Because of its intended use in merchant convoys, it also has a fair amount of cargo space.

variants.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Leviathan has been in service since long before the Republic existed. Although considered today to be an outdated and clunky model, it is still a force to be reckoned with.

variants.description: A mid-sized transport to fill in the gap between Blackbird and Star Queen, as well as serving as an economy-class transport.

variants.name: Quicksilver (Rangphenn Escort)
variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: CH-6 Carrack (Atomic I)
variants.description: Carrack is an old heavy freighter for long range shipping, dating back to early days of the Republic. It has enough bays for a small complement of fighters, to assist with landing and other tasks, back in the days. In more recent times these bays often carry combat fighters to help defend the ship.

variants.name: Behemoth (Atomic, Jacks)
variants.description: The Behemoth is a recent ship design from Betelgeuse Shipyards, designed as an alternative to the Syndicate Bulk Freighter. Although its cargo capacity is somewhat lower, it is also more maneuverable, and packs a heavier armament by default.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor (NBSL)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.name: CK50T Stahbar (NBSL)
variants.description: This is a large armoured freighter with decent armaments, which is also plated with special material for scattering radar, making it more difficult for radar-based missiles to lock-on. According to the company representative however, this feature was an accident as they were developing their coating.

variants.name: CDB-6K Jupiter (NBSL)
variants.description: A dry bulk carrier geared with derricks for unloading cargo in less-equipped ports, in the earlier days of bulk interstellar trade. Unlike container ships, these bulk carriers can be loaded with unpacked dry cargoes like ores and grain directly in their cargo bays, lessening the need for the cargo to be packaged from the destination.

variants.name: CDB-12K Saturn (NBSL)
variants.description: A class of even larger dry bulk carriers than the Jupiter as exports and demand grew. Unfortunately, due to the lack of unloading gears, it's operation is limited to fewer more well equipped ports. In addition to its' bulk bays it can also carry significant amount of containers, allowing captains to earn additional profit.

variants.name: Bastion (NBSL)
variants.description: The Southbound Shipyards Bastion is designed as a heavy defense platform to accompany freighter convoys, in addition to having enough cargo capacity to serve as a freighter in its own right. Because of its heavy armament, it is classified as a warship rather than a freighter.

variants.name: Lance (MGF: NBSL)
variants.description: The Lance is the primary fighter used by the Republic Navy. As with all fighters, it is weak by itself but very effective as part of a larger squadron. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

variants.name: Finch (MGF: NBSL)
variants.description: When the Free Worlds started requesting a Carrier solution from its local shipyards, Tarazed Shipyards quickly saw that a few modifications could make their entry level interceptor into a top tier fighter. Over 85% of the parts that make up the Finch are shared with the Sparrow assembly line, so it's no surprise that even trimmed down to (barely) fit into a fighter bay, the blindingly fast Finch bears strong resemblance to its hyperspace-faring cousin. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

variants.name: MGF: Spetum Class (Spetum Class (Mark II))

variants.description: A fast and well armoured freighter for medium-range shipping. Preferred by some captains for greater manoeuvrability compared to Syndicate Freighter.

variants.name: TS-CH0 Kratzbal (Plasma Steering)
variants.description: A fast and well-armed transport for hauling large amounts of people across long distances as a non-luxury alternative to the Star Queen.

variants.description: A slightly bigger version of the Catirfel with all cargo pods arranged on the same side, for ease of access and unloading at port. The ship is also equipped with a large array of missile launchers to deter pirates, who are becoming stronger as time progress.

variants.name: LMS-43 Mullsammler (Quad Blaster)
variants.description: This ship was designed to collect garbage from various colonies in the days before they built their own garbage processing plants. With their compactors these ships can collect several times more cargo than a regular freighter. Even after a processing plant was built on a planet these vessels are still used to collect garbage from various settlements scattered around the planet. The ship is equipped with six compactors to quickly load the garbage, though practically the crew said three is more than enough for most small settlements this ship would be visiting and all compactors will only be utilized in more urban areas.

variants.name: QYG-30r Qazan (Quad Blaster)

variants.name: QYG-60 Sandiq (Quad Blaster)

variants.name: QYG-60 Sandiq (Feiyu Turret)

variants.name: FUe02a Gebrant (G22)
variants.description: A general heavy freight pusher introduced before the forming of the Republic. variants.description: A Gebrant with two cargo containers attached.

variants.name: FUe06a Gebrant III (G22)

variants.description: A recently developed warship with focus on turrets and use it to tear down their opponent from any angle unlike most other warship on the market at the time of release. It also comes with unique weapon to surprise any enemy they face and rapidly tear down their shields.

The ship also features a crane for assisting unloading operations in less equipped ports, which can be retracted and hidden inside the hull to protect it from in-flight damage.

The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: Sparrow (Black Death)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.name: Hawk (Black Death)
variants.description: The Tarazed Hawk is an interceptor-class warship often used as an escort for freighters or in a planetary militia's patrol squadron. Hawks are fast enough to chase down most smaller ships, but are capable of mounting much more powerful weapons. They are also, of course, a favorite ship of pirate captains who have earned enough money to afford one.

variants.name: Fury (Black Death)
variants.description: The Fury is Southbound Shipyards' most popular design of escort ship. They have greater firepower than any other interceptor-class vessel, meaning that any pirate flying solo will think twice before attacking a convoy that is accompanied by a Fury. However, Furies are also much less maneuverable than other small ships.

variants.name: Dagger (Black Death)
variants.description: The Dagger is a fighter designed by Lionheart Industries, intended to be carried by their Aerie warship, although other ships have been known to carry them, as well. As with many Lionheart ships, its chassis is largely composed of lightweight composite materials, making it considerably faster than other fighters. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

variants.name: EP-1 Mole (Javelin)
variants.description: An automated mining drone developed and used by Espion Mining Co. Due to their specialized nature these drones come with built-in asteroid scanners.

variants.name: EP-1 Mole (Torpedo)
variants.description: An automated mining drone developed and used by Espion Mining Co. Due to their specialized nature these drones come with built-in asteroid scanners.

variants.name: EM-28F Wombat (Combat)
variants.description: Espion-exclusive mining carrier, or rather a mobile mining and refinery station to extract and process resources on the go as due to its large cargo holds it may spend much of its time in flight to collect a full cargo of resources. Because of its size and slowness, the vessel is less than ideal for mining and collecting resources itself, but instead relies on a sizable fleet of fighters and drones to mine and collect resources for it. To protect their miners from harm as they operate far away from the mothership, the Wombat also comes with space for 4 pocket light warships to guard the miners.

variants.name: EM-8A Armadillo (Armadillo (Weapon))
variants.description: Espion-exclusive light mining carrier with sizeable squadron of drones and fighters for defending itself, or help mining and collecting materials.

variants.name: Sunder (Espion)
variants.description: The Sunder is a versatile mining platform equipped with dedicated prospecting equipment, most notably an undercarriage that supports two Mining Drones. The lineage of this ship can be traced back to the old asteroid mining ships used in the Sol Main Belt centuries ago; however, because of recent Syndicate efforts to further exploit the Core's mineral wealth, the newest model of the Sunder is now manufactured by Syndicated Shipyards.

variants.name: Mining Drone (Espion)
variants.description: The semi-autonomous Mining Drone is used by the Syndicate alongside the Sunder mining vessel in a supportive role. Not being much more than a Mining Laser with an engine stuck to the rear of it, these drones do not last long in combat with other ships due to how fragile they are. 	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a drone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a drone bay.

variants.name: Clipper (Espion)
variants.description: The Clipper is the smaller sister ship to the popular Southbound Shipyards Argosy. Although not able to carry as much cargo, Clippers are versatile ships that can be used as passenger transports, couriers, or even warships in a pinch, and they come with enough free space to be customized based on an individual captain's needs.

variants.description: Although Betelgeuse Shipyards produces other ship models as well, the majority of their profits come from sales of the Shuttle. Shuttles are not designed to withstand combat of any sort, but they are fast and maneuverable enough to get out of harm's way if attacked by a larger, slower ship. Although they are typically unarmed, they have enough space for one weapon, which is the origin of the popular phrase, "as useless as a blaster cannon on a shuttlecraft."

variants.description: This is a large armoured freighter with decent armaments, which is also plated with special material for scattering radar, making it more difficult for radar-based missiles to lock-on. variants.description: Results of pirates wondering what to do with captured Bulk Freighters as they were too slow and cumbersome for smuggling. The Battle Bulk were often used to battle against rival gang or the navy.

variants.description: To improve upon the Behemoth's already decent combat capability the pirates made extensive modifications to it and turn it into proper warship with large cargo hold perfect for plundering.

variants.name: PL-50 Impavid (Upgrade 1)
variants.description: A well defended livestock transport for shipping various live exports from the southern worlds to their destination safely. Unlike its sea-bound ancestor which can simply have an open deck for air, the cargo decks of a spacefaring livestock transport require dedicated climate control systems to ensure proper air circulation and comfortable ride for the animals, as well as reduce the smells and gases for when the crew have to perform tasks within the cargo deck. 	Freshly butchered meat is known to be highly preferred over frozen meat by the wealthy, creating a lucrative trade route between the South and Paradise Planets for these specialized freighters.

variants.name: TS-1L260 Mieusbar (Proton)
variants.description: A huge liner for mass transportation across vast distances. The development was partially sponsored by some of the southern worlds in effort to provide cheaper transportation for migrating workers and low-budget tourists, specifically those coming to the southern area.

variants.name: FG-11 Starcarrier (NBSL)
variants.description: A mid-sized container ship offering both great capacity and the benefits of containerization.

variants.name: FG-5 Bluewhale (Proton)
variants.description: Bluewhale is a massive freighter for hauling large amount of cargo across the galaxy. Due to its' cost these ships are often owned by freight companies rather than individuals. While it's capable of carrying much more cargo than most other freighters, one of the major complaints received from captains is that it can take very long to reach the innermost container. That said it is still far faster and easier than handling of bulk cargo.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor (Feiyu Turret)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. variants.name: CDB-6K Jupiter (G22)
variants.description: A dry bulk carrier geared with derricks for unloading cargo in less-equipped ports, in the earlier days of bulk interstellar trade. Unlike container ships, these bulk carriers can be loaded with unpacked dry cargoes like ores and grain directly in their cargo bays, lessening the need for the cargo to be packaged from the destination.

variants.name: FG-10 Exchanger (Post-Lucerne)
variants.description: Inspired by the Syndicate H-class super container ship, a smaller freighter development was halted in favor of an even larger freighter, perhaps the largest freighter to ever be developed in human space. The hull of the smaller predecessor in development was modified and used as the Exchanger primary cargo arms that can be deployed to land and unload cargo, as the Exchanger itself is too large to land on any port. 	To protect itself the ship carries a vast array of armaments rivalling most warships as well as entire wings of fighters to protect itself. Though the sub cargo ships attached to the arms can be deployed, they were stripped down too much to serve as effective combat ship on its' own. In addition there is also a longer delay to deploy, as they were not designed for immediate action.

Due to its design, the ship cannot land without dedicated gear to accept it and is intended to stay in orbit instead, while a fleet of transfer ships carried with it unload the cargo in bulk. Due to the size of its bays it can even carry heavy warships alongside to protect itself.

variants.name: H-Class Super Container Ship (NGK)
variants.thumbnail: thumbnail/mgf syn hclass super container thumb
variants.description: This massive super container ship is the next step in the Syndicate's attempt to regain dominance over the heavy freighter market, with over double the capacity of the previous largest freighter. Similarly to its predecessor, the G-Class Container Transport, it carries a fleet of drones to assist in unloading, as well as allowing it to unload at smaller spaceports that may not be able to handle its size, by simply parking in orbit and transporting containers to surface with the ship's own drones and tugboats from the port instead. This allows the ship to visit most if not all ports without worrying about landing area or unloading gears delivering both large and small amount of cargo to various destination.

variants.name: CK80T Tlielart (Tlielart (Long Range))
variants.description: A massive freighter designed to carry as much cargo as possible, and did so exceedingly that it surpass the capacity of every other ships by far. Though unlike the other ships from MarStel Industries, it is very lightly armed relative to cargo capacity, making it lack the firepower to properly protect itself and neither does it have the speed to dodge any raider. Due to such reasons, it will require decent escort to safely travel. 	Though it carries more than most, if not all, freighters in human space, the sheer amount of cargo that has to be unloaded requires ungodly amount of time, equipment, and manpower, which only gets worse when loading cargo. Any less than a well developed urban spaceport will struggle to service the ship and often will take a few days to complete the operation, if they ever require this much cargo in the first place. This results in the ship being not quite a popular choice in most of human space, as few planets require this much cargo in a single delivery and fewer capable of handling it.

variants.name: Quicksilver (MGF: Zhizhe)
variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: Argosy (MGF: Leiqiang)
variants.description: The Argosy from Southbound Shipyards is very popular with merchants not because of its capacity, which is actually slightly smaller than the Syndicate Freighter, but because it can hold its own in combat even against a small pirate fleet. 	The Argosy is also a very easy ship to upgrade with faster engines or more powerful weapons as needed, so many privately owned Argosies have very different capabilities than the stock model.

variants.name: Bastion (MGF: Zhizhe)
variants.description: The Southbound Shipyards Bastion is designed as a heavy defense platform to accompany freighter convoys, in addition to having enough cargo capacity to serve as a freighter in its own right. Because of its heavy armament, it is classified as a warship rather than a freighter.

variants.name: Firebird (MGF: RD-560)
variants.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Firebird is a warship with a long and storied past; Firebirds fought on both sides of the Alpha Wars over half a millennium ago, and although the equipment and systems have been upgraded continuously since then, the basic design remains almost the same. The Firebird is also a very rugged ship and easy to repair; supposedly a few of the Firebirds that fought in those wars are still in service today.

variants.name: Freighter (MGF: KDB)
variants.description: The Freighter is designed by the Syndicate to be an efficient means of carrying cargo from system to system, but is so slow and difficult to land that most pilots hate flying them. 	Freighters are an obvious target for pirates, but turn much too slowly to be able to bring any forward-facing guns to bear on an approaching enemy. As a result, the latest model of freighter is equipped only with turrets, including an anti-missile turret to prevent attackers from simply bombarding them into submission from a safe distance.

variants.name: Modified Argosy (MGF: EACN)
variants.description: The Argosy has long been a favorite ship for pirates, who have come up with many tricks for modifying them to be more suitable as warships.

variants.name: Clipper (MGF: ShiKv-190)
variants.description: The Clipper is the smaller sister ship to the popular Southbound Shipyards Argosy. Although not able to carry as much cargo, Clippers are versatile ships that can be used as passenger transports, couriers, or even warships in a pinch, and they come with enough free space to be customized based on an individual captain's needs.

variants.name: LGC-3 Mesa (Mesa (LNG Filled))
variants.description: A purpose-built gas tanker used for shipping large amount of gas in liquefied or compressed form across the galaxy. Relatively rare due to their specialized nature mostly running along a few industrial worlds. Lightly armed but also less likely to attract pirate attention due to difficulty of storing and maintaining liquefied or compressed gas, making it one of the least economical targets for them. While pretty much useless in most situations, a gas tanker allows you to take special, very well paid jobs on some industrial planets. 	Due to nature of liquefied gas requiring extremely low temperature to maintain, any overheating can damage the tanks over time and eventually can cause it to burst. For that reason gas tanker captains must keep a close eye on their temperature at all time and make sure the temperature is always below the limit.

variants.name: LXC-2 Strata (Strata (Sulfuric Acid Filled))
variants.description: This is a purpose-built chemical tanker for shipping various industrial chemicals, including highly corrosive acids, with efficiency unmatched by regular freighters. Due to their specialized nature these ships are also rarer and most often found in route between industrial planets or close by. With the difficulty of efficiently maintaining transported chemicals combined with requiring special ports to unload the stored liquid, these vessels are less preferred target for pirates. While not useful in general shipping between most worlds, these ships profit of their extreme specialization to take on fewer but much more profitable jobs which are only offered on industrialized worlds.

variants.name: TQK-20 Qaytas (White Sugar)
variants.description: A specialized bulk-in bag-out ship designed in cooperation between Vefrol Dockyards and Pioneer Heavy Industries for the Core Food Corporation. This is to allow transportation of bulk sugar and in-ship bagging at destination to decrease port time during unloading, resulting in overall faster turnaround. The ship lacks large cargo loading hatches to maintain a closed system free of contaminants and instead loads via special sealed conveyor belts built into the ship. Its' built-in bagging facilities utilize the latest technology for fast and highly efficient packaging operation. Bagged sugar can be unloaded at the port far faster than in bulk as well as having the benefit of being less reliant on specialized sugar unloading equipment and storage that most ports do not have.

variants.name: MGF: Nasprite (Nasprite (Syndicate Border Patrol))
variants.description: Nasprite is a modernization of a dated armoured freighter design from the first turf war made to withstand combat and long travel. Though originates from the core, most of these are now found operating around the Dirt Belt.

variants.name: Vanguard (MGF CoreNucMKII)
variants.description: The Vanguard is Syndicated Systems' newest warship intended for the heavy anti-pirate defense market. Vanguards offer an unusual feature set, focusing on powerful fixed guns and featuring Syndicated Systems' latest automation technologies, resulting in an atypically low crew complement for a ship its size. Few capital ships will endure for long under the withering fusillade of gunfire that it can unleash against those in front of it.

variants.name: SRC-41C Curie (Downgraded)
variants.description: The Curie-class is a purpose-built nuclear fuel carrier dedicated to transporting all sorts of radioactive cargo, like fresh nuclear fuel, spent nuclear fuel, and radioactive waste, with multiple redundancies for all critical systems, from engines, cooling system, electrical systems to navigation systems as well as reinforced bulkheads to resist even the most extreme accident while keeping their cargo intact. Though the bridge is visible, it is reinforced with additional armour and is mainly only used for landing and on-ground operations like unloading the cargo, with the ship's primary control room buried deep inside the ship, with another layer of armour around it, not unlike what one would have expected from a warship. With the requirement to keep the cargo cool all the time the ship also has a built-in dedicated cooling system for the cargo hold, which is isolated from the cooling systems for the rest of the ship as well as having its own backup generator. Though all radioactive cargo comes with its own radiation shielding container, the material for this ship's cargo hold is also selected to provide decent amount of shielding as well. 	Another part of the ship's safety includes crews specially trained to handle radioactive cargo as well as responding to various foreseeable incidents, from collision, fire, and pirates boarding, in the most unlikely case that it occurs. In addition to that, the ship is also equipped for in-flight repairs, allowing the ship to perform rudimentary repairs on itself if damaged, though there is a small delay before the repair can begin and longer delay if the ship got disabled. Because all of these facts the ship's minimum crew is almost the same as chemical tankers of larger size and operating cost is one of the highest.

variants.name: Sparrow (Rakin)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.name: Scrapper (Rakin)
variants.description: Rather than being a specific model of ship, the Scrappers are instead a family of vessels cobbled together from the remains of broken shuttles. On the rare occasion that Republic authorities bother to recognize their existence, Scrappers are treated as almost-illegal, patent-infringing death traps. Despite this, these ships are where many captains (and pirates) from poorer backgrounds get their start.

variants.name: E-FD23 Kanran (Ankulah)
variants.description: Kanran is a very old destroyer designed by MJK heavy industries for their security department to protect their properties as well as raiding enemy convoys during the first turf war and sequentially also participated in the Alpha War. At its time it was considered one of the most advanced ship in the sky second only to those from the Deep and with sheer number it was manufactured many survived the conflict and were continually improved that some still survives to this day. Production of this model fluctuates over time but generally on descending trend before stopping not long after the formation of the Republic. Now most of Kanran on the market are ones decomissioned from NGK fleets.

variants.name: Enforcer (Ankulah, Defensive)
variants.description: Prior to the formation of the galactic Republic, many star systems were owned by "governing corporate entities," with the vast majority of space being inaccessible to private citizens. The only exception to this rule were the pirate bands, whose few ships were often stolen or rebellious corporate fleets of their own, yet who had an outsized impact on interstellar trade. The necessity for corporations to protect their operations meant that Enforcer was one of the most common vessels used for security and defense. The ship boasts an armament of four gun ports and a turreted mount, all packed on a small but defensible frame that was powerful for its time. 	Although no longer on the market, the Enforcer finds itself in the possession of a small number of merchants and, ironically, various groups of pirates, as an aging combat ship easily outperformed by other light warships or even interceptors of a similar size.

The ship also employ the latest S-270 Shield Regenerator and thus have pre-tuned shields to work with this specific shield regenerator. variants.description: Kinesaki is one of MJK Heavy Industries ancient freighter design developed shortly before the first turf war. It's also known to be fairly capable in combat and contributes to significant amount of firepower in combat. There's even stories of some that served as powerful Q-Ship, one so lethal that few survived to tell the tale. Over time, Kinesaki-class were slowly phased out for newer, more efficient, and better protected cargo ships. Last of its' class was decommissioned from NGK fleet a few decades before the formation of the Republic. 	Although outdated and largely outperformed by more modern ships, it is still good enough for few merchants and small companies to keep it in service. While unlikely due to sheer amount of it built over time, it's probable that some of these ships in service may well be over half-millenia old. 	With the production of Kinesaki-class officially ceased centuries ago, most that are on sale right now are ancient stocks from since. variants.name: F-VC56 Kaga (Early)
variants.description: Initially a plan pitched to the Republic Navy as they seek a new fleet carrier with enough capacity for 80 fighters now brought back into development as they realized the looming threat of aliens from all sides and funding to spare. Though the original plan was already considerably expensive, the additional development and modernization for new goal rise the cost through the roof. Unlike its predecessors Zuiho and Zuikaku the Kaga was not designed for mercantile escort (and for advertisement) and deterrence with most threat being large pirate fleet where it still have to be somewhat economically viable to build and operate. Kaga Class is designed for greatest chance of victory in combat against potentially more advanced alien with capacity for 90 fighters spread across 3 flight decks for rapid deployment and recovery along with a large array of cutting-edge armaments to out gun any alien warship it may find.

variants.name: H-BS140 Yamato (Early)
variants.description: The Yamato is a heavy battleship designed to utilize few large and heavy turret as primary armament drawing inspiration from an ancient naval battleship of the same name. It also uses large array of VLS missiles as additional firepower. To compensate for lack of turn rate of the large turret it employs a large array of smaller turrets to protect itself against smaller and faster vessels and missiles. Large spinal cannon is also equipped on bow of the ship that can deal a massive amount of damage to any enemy vessel. The ship is also notably a lot larger than its namesake to fit all the required technologies employing latest iteration of highly efficient and durable shield emitter as well as large array of defensive anti-missile and anti-fighter turrets.

variants.name: CDB-6K Jupiter (NGK, Partial Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: A dry bulk carrier geared with derricks for unloading cargo in less-equipped ports, in the earlier days of bulk interstellar trade. Unlike container ships, these bulk carriers can be loaded with unpacked dry cargoes like ores and grain directly in their cargo bays, lessening the need for the cargo to be packaged from the destination.

variants.name: FG-5 Bluewhale-A (NGK, Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: Bluewhale is a massive freighter for hauling large amount of cargo across the galaxy. Due to its' cost these ships are often owned by freight companies rather than individuals. While it's capable of carrying much more cargo than most other freighters, one of the major complaints received from captains is that it can take very long to reach the innermost container. That said it is still far faster and easier than handling of bulk cargo.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor-A (NGK, Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.name: LVC-2 Sandura (NGK, Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: A specialized roll-on roll-off ship for efficiently transporting land vehicles in large number, by having the interior laid out akin to parking lot, allowing vehicles to be driven on and off the ship by itself fast and easily without having to wait for cranes. Because the interior is essentially a large empty space, other cargo can also be stored, allowing it to be more flexible than other specialized ships like tankers. 	Because of the highly valuable cargo and relative lack of defences these ships rely heavily on escorts for protection.

variants.name: Marauder Quicksilver (XGS Escort)
variants.description: This Megaparsec Quicksilver is a bit of a hotrod, being a little faster, with extra shield projectors, hull plating, and an extra bunk. This aftermarket model also features a turret mount, perhaps in an answer to Lionheart's Headhunter. The shop that built this ship is sure to see more customers.

variants.name: SV40-n Navilel (Hai)
variants.description: A slightly bigger version of the Catirfel with all cargo pods arranged on the same side, for ease of access and unloading at port. The ship is also equipped with a large array of missile launchers to deter pirates, who are becoming stronger as time progress.

variants.name: TS-1L260 Mieusbar (Hai)
variants.description: A huge liner for mass transportation across vast distances. The development was partially sponsored by some of the southern worlds in effort to provide cheaper transportation for migrating workers and low-budget tourists, specifically those coming to the southern area.

variants.name: QYG-70r Tonazqi (Hai)
variants.description: A dedicated reefer ship for carrying and keeping perishable goods refrigerated in bulk over distance, with dedicated cargo hold cooling systems as well as a dedicated freezer section for storing cargo that requires an even lower temperature to transport safely.

variants.name: GKS-48 Zummenstoss (Hai)
variants.description: A recently developed warship with focus on turrets and use it to tear down their opponent from any angle unlike most other warship on the market at the time of release. It also comes with unique weapon to surprise any enemy they face and rapidly tear down their shields.

variants.name: Marauder Leviathan (MGF: Weapons 1)
variants.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Leviathan has been in service for a long time, and captains have had some very interesting ideas about how to modify them for optimum performance. This one has had the hull surface completely stripped and replaced, with the new layout containing more shield projectors per square meter.

variants.name: Marauder Splinter (MGF: Weapons 1)
variants.description: The Splinter is the largest warship produced by Megaparsec. Apparently someone wanted a bit more out of it, and has covered large sections of the hull with extra shield emitters and hull plating. Much of the stock cargo space has been converted to outfit, weapons, and engines space; coupled with a streamlining of existing internal systems, it makes this warship an agile and flexible war machine.

variants.name: Marauder Manta (MGF: Engines, Javelin)
variants.description: After the Syndicate released their Vanguard Heavy Warship, the Manta fell somewhat out of favor due to its lack of ability to mount any anti-missile turrets. The owner of this Manta rectified that, added some extra armor plating and shield emitters, and rearranged some of the internals to yield a little more outfit space. Dry tonnage alone keeps it from being classified as a heavy warship.

variants.name: Marauder Splinter (Minotaurs 1, Engines)
variants.description: The Splinter is the largest warship produced by Megaparsec. Apparently someone wanted a bit more out of it, and has covered large sections of the hull with extra shield emitters and hull plating. Much of the stock cargo space has been converted to outfit, weapons, and engines space; coupled with a streamlining of existing internal systems, it makes this warship an agile and flexible war machine.

variants.name: MGF: Battle Behemoth (Battle Behemoth (Minotaurs 1))
variants.description: To improve upon the Behemoth's already decent combat capability the pirates made extensive modifications to it and turn it into proper warship with large cargo hold perfect for plundering.

variants.name: MGF: Aplomado (Aplomado (Minotaurs I))
variants.description: Started from some veteran pirates modifying their Falcon to suit their need of long range durable cargo ship which eventually results in the Aplomado. Very little of the Falcon it was based on is left as the ship was upgraded and redesigned over the years, with other pirate captain showing interest and present enough money the Aplomado eventually becomes mass produced.

variants.name: Cruiser (Minotaurs I)
variants.description: The Republic Cruiser is a relatively recent design, a much larger version of the Frigate designed to be able to take on an entire pirate fleet if necessary. In addition to a wide variety of weaponry, Cruisers have space to carry four attack drones: fast, pilotless fighters that can be controlled remotely.

variants.name: CS-24 Garrison (Minotaurs 1)
variants.description: Garrison is a light carrier for protecting merchant convoy and base for guarding trade route.

variants.name: Shield Beetle (Minotaurs I)
variants.description: This ship was first built millennia ago, near the end of a more violent time in Hai history. Since then, it has served as the only heavy warship at the disposal of the Hai. The Shield Beetle is a versatile warship used by the Hai to guard their merchant convoys, or by the Unfettered to attack those very same convoys.

variants.name: Shield Beetle (Minotaurs II)
variants.description: This ship was first built millennia ago, near the end of a more violent time in Hai history. Since then, it has served as the only heavy warship at the disposal of the Hai. The Shield Beetle is a versatile warship used by the Hai to guard their merchant convoys, or by the Unfettered to attack those very same convoys.

variants.name: Falcon (Automaton)
variants.description: The Tarazed Falcon is one of the most powerful warships that civilians can buy, a sleeker and more maneuverable alternative to the venerable and somewhat outdated Leviathan.

variants.name: Leviathan (Automaton)
variants.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Leviathan has been in service since long before the Republic existed. Although considered today to be an outdated and clunky model, it is still a force to be reckoned with.

variants.name: MGF: Culverin Class (Culverin Class (Automaton))
variants.description: A large arsenal ship recently developed and deployed by the navy. The Culverin Class arsenal ship carries over dozens of missile launchers and over half a thousand missiles to saturate the entire battlefield with enough missiles to easily overwhelm even the best anti-missile system available.

outfits.name: VolHex-1070 Guardian Turret
outfits.description: Large City-sized octa-gun turret that fires slow but devastating shots. Each turret is so large it is nearly an entire ship on its own, completed with living area and other systems to support both the guns and the crews maintaining it.

outfits.description: Extremely large and powerful hyperdrive and Jump Drive hybrid capable of getting larger objects into hyperspace at higher speed than regular hyperdrive.

outfits.name: Rugol Nullspace Generator
outfits.description: What appears to be the power generator for the Agrunnos that's capable of outputting large amount of power and improve shield generation.

outfits.name: Ruo-Al Shield Node

outfits.name: MGF: Voidfish (Fresh)
outfits.description: These are a collection of numerous species of voidborne fish harvested in not the most ideal manner but also not the worst it can be. They are surprisingly appetizing, and equally nourishing.

outfits.name: Crude Oil
outfits.description: Unprocessed oil right from the oil rig to be transported to a refinery for processing into various petroleum-based products.

outfits.name: Gasoline
outfits.description: A petroleum-derived product now commonly used as ingredient for other products and rarely as fuel for some specialized industry and vehicle.

outfits.name: Machine Oil

outfits.name: Kerosene
outfits.description: A low-viscosity hydrocarbon derived from petroleum used in some chemical process and occasionally as fuel for specialized machines.

outfits.name: Bagger Excavator
outfits.description: An old-school physical excavator build into the tip of the Bagger. While it lacks range, it will break up asteroids much faster than any other energy weapon in human space.

outfits.name: Thyrupp Industrial Systems
outfits.description: Complete industrial system for processing ores and manufacturing basic products built into the ship. Need one landing after purchase to activate the system. This system will refine certain amount of harvested material everyday as long as it's installed on the flag ship. Requires at least 10 tons of harvested material to process into 10 tons of refined materials. Refined materials can be further processed into products 2 tons at a time. Max 1 of the Thyrupp Industrial Systems can be stacked, beyond that will have no effect.

outfits.name: Kotroger Excavator Turret
outfits.description: Massive turreted bucket excavator of the Kotroger-class mining vehicle primarily for terrestrial mining but could also be operated in space as well though not as effective. The arm can be extended to increase reach.

outfits.name: Reisen Sidehull
outfits.description: Sidehull of the MJK Reisen houses 4 blasters of unspecified type and the auxiliary thruster contributing to 2/3rd of the ship's steering and reverse thrust capability. Though, the ability to thrust laterally is suspciously missing despite the degree of freedom that definitely allow that capability.

outfits.name: M-type 1k Gas Tank
outfits.description: Universal gas tank capable of storing either liquefied gas or compressed gas built into the LGC-3 Mesa class gas tanker ships allowing it to transport gases without relaying on special containers improving speed, capacity, and overall efficiency of the transportation. These tanks are built with high strength materials to withstand extremely high pressure and layered with advanced insulations along with dedicated cooling systems to keep the cargo at right temperature. Having ships with dedicated gas tanks allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting gas.

outfits.name: U-type 1k Chemical Tank
outfits.description: Universal chemical tank made to safely store even the most corrosive liquid built for dedicated chemical tanker for shipping various industrial chemicals with far superior efficiency compared to regular freighter. The tanks are made with thick corrosion resistant material and coated with another layer of specialized corrosion-proof coating. Lined with dedicated temperature control system to keep the cargo at ideal heat for transport unaffected by the environment around the ship. Having ships with dedicated chemical tanks as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting industrial chemicals.

outfits.name: U-type 1k Cement Tank
outfits.description: Dedicated cement tank without hatch and instead loaded and unloaded by it's own dedicated system.

outfits.name: B-type 1k Oil Tank
outfits.description: An oil tank for transporting both crude oil and processed petroleum products. Lined with heater to prevent the cargo from being too viscous to be pumped out. Surrounded with triple-layered armour to prevent leaks and protect the cargo as well as the environment of the planet. Having ships with dedicated oil tanks as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting oil and petroleum products.

outfits.name: B-type 1k Bitumen Tank
outfits.description: An bitumen tank specially designed to handle heat to keep the bitumen from solidifying. Each tank have dedicated heating system to control the temperature and keep it within the requirement. Having ships with dedicated bitumen tanks as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting bitumen.

outfits.name: C-type 200 Water Tank
outfits.description: A simple vacuum-rated fresh water tank for transporting fresh water to colonies or station which are unable to produce enough fresh water themselves also occasionally used to assist firefighting operations especially forest fire where large volume of water is required. Having ships with dedicated water tank as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting water.

outfits.name: C-type 100 Wine Tank
outfits.description: Specially designed wine tank with special coating and temperature control systems to perfectly maintain the wine quality during transport. Having ships with dedicated wine tank as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting wine.

outfits.name: C-type 200 Juice Tank
outfits.description: Dedicated refrigerated juice tank each built with their own cooling system to maintain the perfect temperature of their cargo. Having ships with dedicated juice tank as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting juice.

outfits.name: B-type 200 Bulk Sugar Bay
outfits.description: Specialized cargo bay for storing sugar for shipping. Due to importance of purity for sugar the bay is very tightly sealed to avoid any contaminants and not other cargo were allowed to be loaded inside. It is also installed with sensors in various point to monitor the cargo and make sure it's in perfect condition. Having ships with dedicated sugar bay as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting sugar.

outfits.name: U-type 500 Molasses Tank
outfits.description: Purpose-built molasses tank for fast and efficient transportation of molasses. It comes with heating coil to heat the cargo to ideal temperature for pumping out when unloading. The tank interior is also coated with special coating for easier cleaning. Having ships with dedicated molasses tank as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting molasses.

outfits.name: B-type 500 Garbage Bay
outfits.description: Bay for compressed garbage. Having ships with dedicated garbage bay as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting garbage.

outfits.name: C-type 200 Tritium Tank
outfits.description: Specialized tank for carrying tritium and maintain its stability during transportation.

outfits.name: C-type 400 Edibles Tank
outfits.description: Special liquid tank designed to carry edibles liquid made with food grade material and certified by the Republic food and drug administration.

outfits.description: Represent 1 ton of refrigerated space.

outfits.description: Represent 1 ton of car parking space.

outfits.name: MGF: Fast Unloading
outfits.description: This ship is capable of unloading its cargo faster than normal or capable of assisting other ship to do so. This reduced port time means greater opportunity for getting more jobs, especially rush jobs. Chances of getting additional jobs varies based on Fast Unloading value in your fleet and the total amount of cargo in your fleet.

outfits.name: Espion Mining Laser
outfits.description: Basic mining laser used by Espion miners that is exceptionally effective to asteroids though the damage will dropoff at longer range.

outfits.name: Espion Mini-Mining Laser
outfits.description: Smaller version of Espion mining laser with closer dropoff range at half total range and lower damage and heat efficiency than full-sized.

outfits.name: Espion Heavy Tractor
outfits.description: Larger, longer ranged version of the Tractor Beam developed by Espion for use on their larger mining ships. Though not much improvement on velocity, it's effective range is beyond double of the regular model.

outfits.name: Vik's Snatcher
outfits.description: A modification made to the tractor beam by the pirates to fire in burst with significantly increased attraction power. This allows the pirate to quickly grab dumped cargoes and get out before a patrol arrives.

outfits.name: Ritic's Overcharged MLaser
outfits.description: Modified version of a stolen Espion Mini-Mining Laser. Capable of more powerful beam in a short burst. Named after the pirate who first made this modification and almost lost a limb doing so.

outfits.name: JX-2 Overdriven Gatling Turret
outfits.description: Heavily modified version of pirate gatling gun with active cooling to negate the heat generated and permits continuous firing as well as improved mechanism and refitted parts for better reliability and performance. The tool marking and finishes on this seems to indicate it was handmade and not a mass-produced weapon, likely from some privateer that happen to get their hands on it from plundering pirates and was disappointed with its performance.

outfits.name: Mixture-DX Corrosive Thrower
outfits.description: Special weapon that fires sticky, corrosive liquid that melts away enemy hull, developed and used by the Black Death pirate group. It also disrupts engine functionality.

outfits.name: Chem-VT Disruptor Thrower
outfits.description: A thrower for a special chemical that disrupt functionality of shield matrix but harmless against armour. It is used by Black Death pirate group to defeat the advanced shield used by modern warships. Though the chemical is experimental and very unstable.

outfits.name: Karlok's Repulsor Cannon
outfits.description: Cheap and powerful cannon made from welding a bunch of commonly found repulsor engines together and overcharge it to the extreme. The result is a gun single-shot gun capable of delivering more sophisticated shell at high velocity. These are used by a few group of pirate to deal with heavily shielded and armoured warships used by merchant convoys.

outfits.description: Ammunition for V2000 Basilisk Cannon.

outfits.description: One of Edward's side project when he came across some interesting pieces of scrap. The chainsaw can deal large amount of damage to unshielded ships but requires the user to be within melee range of enemy craft. Instead, many captains find this to be more useful as mining tool.

outfits.description: Experimental ultra-compressed plasma cannon, very powerful against shields.

outfits.name: K3-K Particle Turret
outfits.description: A re-engineered and modernized particle cannon by MJK Heavy Industries for their new carrier Zuikaku-class. Syncing the firing of two guns together and increasing the damage per shot closer to modern model while maintaining the rapid firerate of the G22 model resulting in a very formidable weapon to allow the Zuikaku-class to handle pirate ambushes with ease and match up with the notorious heavily modified Marauder ships.

outfits.name: K3-K-S Particle Turret
outfits.description: Single gun version of MJK Heavy Industries particle turret to be used by NGK Hauling ships for improved firepower and range over the commonly used proton turrets.

outfits.name: K2-K-S Particle Turret
outfits.description: Older version of the K3-K-S turret with less performance overall.

outfits.description: Improved and miniturized particle cannon developed specifically for the Reisen fighter. Powerful for the size as well as being very energy hungry.

outfits.description: Single turret version of K4-Ms particle cannon.

outfits.name: K4-H Particle Turret
outfits.description: Improved and larger successor of the K3-K particle turret.

outfits.name: H6-Gy Oscillator Turret
outfits.description: A new type of energy weapon with improved heat efficiency at minimal firepower loss compared to particle weapons.

outfits.name: T3-S-T Heavy Shock Turret
outfits.description: Massive primary turret of the Yamato-class Heavy Battleship with the mass of an entire small ship. It requires a direct powerline from a special type of reactor developed by MJK Heavy Industries. Capable of crippling a medium-sized warship in a single blow. Because of its sheer size it requires a dedicated crew housed inside the turret as well as independent backup targeting system allowing it to still operate if the ship's main targeting system is down.

outfits.name: T2-A-T Shock Turret
outfits.description: Three-gun Shock turret made as secondary weapon for the Yamato-class.

outfits.name: Q4L Pulse Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Heavy Anti-Missile Turret has a longer range, higher power, and shorter reload time than its smaller sibling. The only way to overcome it is by firing missiles in a cluster so that while one is being targeted, the others can get through, and as a result all missile systems on the market now default to firing in clusters if multiple copies of the same launcher are installed, rather than staggering their fire as ordinary guns do.

outfits.name: T2L Pulse Turret
outfits.description: Fast-firing anti-fighter employing new generation of blasters with even greater energy efficiency.

outfits.name: MWG-1 Harmonic Cannon
outfits.description: A compact energy-based artillery cannon developed from a proprietary technology that is smaller and more powerful than railgun system used by Republic Navy but consumes vastly more amount of energy as well as far longer cooldown period. It also requires a special set of reactors for it to fire further limiting its use on other ships. Though despite the drawback a single shot from this weapon can decimate an entire fleet.

outfits.name: Type-83 Yoden Torpedo
outfits.description: Typhoon Torpedoes are ammunition for the Typhoon Launcher. Each launcher can hold 30 of them. You cannot install Typhoon Torpedoes unless you have also installed a launcher to fire them from.

outfits.name: Type-83 Yoden Torpedo Launcher
outfits.description: Faster type of torpedo developed by MJK for use in newer warships.

outfits.description: Long range anti-capital artillery gun.

outfits.name: M6-ACS Artillery Turret
outfits.description: Long range anti-capital artillery turret.

outfits.description: Ammo for the LbrC-1 Jaivana cannon turret.

outfits.name: Jaivana Shell Storage
outfits.description: The Jaivana Shell Storage is used to store extra ammunition for LbrC-1 Jaivana Turret.

outfits.name: LbrC-1 Jaivana Turret
outfits.description: With the need to manufacture a turret large enough to fully utilize the huge mount of the Free Worlds new Barbette-class artillery cruiser they quickly developed the Jaivana cannon that rely on physical shells for design simplicity over energy weapons which are far more complicated and takes longer to develop. Though ballistic weapons are not the most ideal against the shield-heavy navy ships the sheer size would make up enough that it'll be the more effective than any smaller turret on the same mount, at least for the time.

outfits.description: Dual ion cannon turret developed for larger ships with enough capacity for them. With how it was designed it also got slightly improved performance and efficiency compared to regular ion cannons to be useful in fewer number.

Although the prototype would've never come to fruition without a ship that can handle it, the development of Altuella came just in time to make use of this huge weapon

outfits.name: MGF: Tripulse Shredder Turret
outfits.description: An early stage in the development of better and faster weaponry to rival that of the Wanderers, the Tripulse Shredder consists of three Pulse Cannons in a single housing. Advancements in cooling capabilities have reduced the heat generated by each shot at the cost of drawing slightly more power. Additionally, the single shared housing results in a less consistent firing pattern, limiting it to bursts. These factors have made the Tripulse Shredder a popular hit-and-run weapon among the Unfettered.

outfits.name: V47 Plasma-Railgun
